metadata.title: ai-voice-bots - Sources
metadata.description: Official and adjacent sources for building production voice bots with Python-first pipelines and telephony integration.

official_sources.name: Pipecat GitHub
official_sources.description: Open-source framework for voice and multimodal conversational AI.

official_sources.name: Pipecat Docs
official_sources.description: Official Pipecat documentation for pipeline design, transports, and processors.

official_sources.name: LiveKit Agents GitHub
official_sources.description: LiveKit's agent framework for real-time voice and multimodal AI applications.

official_sources.name: LiveKit Agents Docs
official_sources.description: Official LiveKit Agents documentation for VoicePipelineAgent and plugins.

official_sources.name: Deepgram Docs
official_sources.description: Deepgram STT/TTS API documentation. Nova-3 is the default STT recommendation.

official_sources.name: ElevenLabs Docs
official_sources.description: ElevenLabs TTS API documentation. Flash v2.5 (eleven_flash_v2_5) for lowest-latency streaming; Turbo v2.5 is functionally equivalent. Eleven v3 not for real-time.

official_sources.name: Cartesia Docs
official_sources.description: Cartesia Sonic TTS API. Ultra-low latency voice synthesis. Sonic-3 is current default; Sonic-3.5 + Ink-2 (streaming TTS/STT stack, shipped Jun 2026) is the newer alternative — verify current benchmark numbers.

official_sources.name: OpenAI Realtime API Docs
official_sources.description: OpenAI Realtime API (GA, out of beta). Model line iterates roughly every 8-10 weeks (gpt-realtime-2 -> gpt-realtime-2.1 / gpt-realtime-2.1-mini as of Jul 2026); verify current model IDs, pricing, and region availability before each release.

adjacent_references.name: Twilio Programmable Voice
adjacent_references.description: Twilio Voice API for phone call management and SIP integration.

adjacent_references.name: Retell AI Docs
adjacent_references.description: Retell AI enterprise voice agent platform documentation.

adjacent_references.name: Telnyx Docs
adjacent_references.description: Telnyx voice and SIP API documentation.

adjacent_references.name: AssemblyAI Docs
adjacent_references.description: AssemblyAI STT API. Universal-2 model for high-accuracy transcription.

adjacent_references.name: Azure Speech Services
adjacent_references.description: Azure Cognitive Services Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech.

adjacent_references.name: PlayHT Docs
adjacent_references.description: PlayHT TTS API for voice cloning and low-latency synthesis.

adjacent_references.name: WebRTC Specification
adjacent_references.description: W3C WebRTC specification for real-time communication.

adjacent_references.name: ITU-T P.800 (MOS)
adjacent_references.description: ITU standard for Mean Opinion Score voice quality measurement.

adjacent_references.name: Deepgram Flux Docs
adjacent_references.description: Deepgram Flux conversational speech recognition — fused STT + turn detection. flux-general-en and flux-general-multi (multilingual GA Apr 2026, ~260ms median end-of-turn).

adjacent_references.name: Pipecat Smart Turn GitHub
adjacent_references.description: Open-weight ~8M-param semantic turn-detection model (Whisper-tiny encoder + classifier). v3.x: ~12ms CPU, ~23 languages, int8 8MB.

adjacent_references.name: EVA-Bench (ServiceNow)
adjacent_references.description: End-to-end voice-agent evaluation framework. Bot-to-bot audio eval scoring EVA-A (accuracy) + EVA-X (experience). arXiv 2605.13841 (May 2026, preprint).
